```
GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/dns_records?type=CNAME
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```

The JSON response will contain a list of DNS record objects; each object has an `id` field that is the related object’s ID. Extract those `id` values to get the list of CNAME record IDs.
